critique_prose:
The gate is too strict in one specific way. Requiring beta in [0.5, 1.5] and separately testing beta = 1 constrains a magnitude that should not be constrained for this use. The right form is a positive, significant MAU correlation estimated independently for each company, with no regard to the magnitude of beta. A gate that kills a real per-name signal because a pooled elasticity falls outside a pre-set band has failed at the thing it was built to protect.

The thinness of the seat-disclosing gate sample is not an objection here. Because the output is per-name, an analysis that works on even one or two relevant companies is fine provided it is defensible on those names.
